description: This file defines a mock class 'MainThreadMock' for the 'IMainThread' interface, used for unit testing within the 'firebolt::rialto::server::mock' namespace. It includes mock methods for client registration, unregistration, and task enqueueing.

classes.name: MainThreadMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMainThread interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Mocks the registration of a client, returning an int32_t status code.

methods.name: unregisterClient
methods.description: Mocks the unregistration of a client identified by clientId.

methods.name: enqueueTask
methods.description: Mocks enqueuing a task for a client.

methods.name: enqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Mocks enqueuing a task and waiting for its completion.
